newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat arrives in PLO-ruled Hebron.
newsitem.headline: Arafat arrives in PLO-ruled Hebron.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat arrived in Hebron on Sunday after Israel handed over of most of the volatile West Bank city to the PLO.
Arafat's helicopter landed amid wild cheering at the the hilltop headquarters from where Israel ruled the city for 30 years.
About 25,000 Hebronites ringed the former military governor's building where some of them had been jailed during the occupation.
Palestinian police could barely control them as the two Palestinian helicopters and their Israeli helicopter escort swooped in.
Hebron was decked with Palestinian flags and Arafat posters for the visit.
A large mural of Arafat erected on a hill smiled down on the enclaves where 400 Jewish settlers live and study in the heart of the town of 100,000 Palestinians.
Arafat was due to make a speech and meet local residents during his one-day visit. He would break the Moslem Ramadan fast at sunset before leaving, his aides said.
